title: Sistema Inteligente de Orientación Vocacional (IA)
summary: A hybrid machine-learning system that guides high-school students toward an engineering or business career path, combining rule-based synthetic profiles with real survey data. A companion notebook, sintetizador.ipynb, uses SDV's TVAESynthesizer to fit a metadata-defined table and sample 1,000 synthetic rows for this pipeline.
needs: Relationship between sintetizador.ipynb's TVAE output and the main README-described rule-based synthetic dataset is unclear.
